text: Context: Email 1: Hello, We have infiltrated your network and encrypted all your data with our state-of-the-art ransomware. Your data to retrieve you must pay 150 Bitcoin. non-negotiable. Instructions will follow once you agree to pay. You have 48 hours. comply failure will result in the public release of your sensitive data. Regards, Lockdown Operations --- Email 2: This is unacceptable. We cannot afford such an amount. We will find another way to deal with this situation. --- Email 3: You seem to misunderstand the situation. We have your client data, financial records, and private emails. Imagine the damage if this goes public. We will reduce the demand to 100 Bitcoin, but this is your final offer.
